00031 // The following ifdef block is the standard way of creating macros which make exporting 
00032 // from a DLL simpler. All files within this DLL are compiled with the FIP_EXPORTS
00033 // symbol defined on the command line. this symbol should not be defined on any project
00034 // that uses this DLL. This way any other project whose source files include this file see 
00035 // FIP_API functions as being imported from a DLL, wheras this DLL sees symbols
00036 // defined with this macro as being exported.
00037 #ifdef FIP_EXPORTS
00038 #define FIP_API __declspec(dllexport)
00039 #else
00040 #define FIP_API __declspec(dllimport)
00041 #endif
00042
